description: Turn authorized stills and already-written intern onboarding notes into one intern onboarding talk per still. This intern welcome video studio writes a speakable first-day talking clip from the handbook, then animates each still into a 2 to 15s onboarding talking clip. Use it for intern briefing videos, intern first-day video, and intern onboarding video that stay one photo, one clip.
